prompt:
Create a NEW transparent full-body combat character from the APPROVED character in image 1. Image 2 is a hand/grip reference only. Do not reuse the failed earlier sprites.

Character: JOKRO. Match image 1's handsome angular adult face, emerald eyes, naturally flowing forest-green hair, black modern long coat with silver piping/buttons, crowned feline sleeve crest, emerald embroidered lining, black trousers and boots. Same consistent refined 2D anime/painterly rendering throughout the face and body. Face must retain the approved mature, intense identity, not become generic, childlike, soft or cross-eyed.

POSE AND GAZE ARE THE PRIORITIES:
Draw an upright, competent IAIDO swordsman in three-quarter SIDE view FACING SCREEN LEFT. His body, nose, pupils and focused gaze all point toward the same offscreen target at SCREEN LEFT, where he is about to draw and cut. He is looking forward along his impending sword-draw direction, NOT looking at the viewer, NOT glancing back, NOT looking down at his hands. The face is visible as a handsome natural three-quarter side angle. Calm concentrated closed mouth, no mouth sword.
Comfortable upright martial stance with slightly flexed knees and grounded feet, front foot toward screen left, rear foot toward screen right. Torso close to vertical, no deep crouch or doubled-over pose. Use the reference's hand mechanics only, not its extreme bending.

EXACT WEAPON MECHANICS:
ONE ordinary Japanese katana, mostly inside ONE black scabbard, carried at his left waist. The black-and-gold wrapped HANDLE points forward to SCREEN LEFT; the black SCABBARD extends backward to SCREEN RIGHT. Same moderate normal katana length as the approved artwork; handle around 24cm, blade around68cm. No extra swords, no overlong handle.
His RIGHT HAND firmly wraps the actual black-and-gold HANDLE immediately in front of the guard, visibly covering the diamond wrapping. His LEFT HAND stabilizes the BLACK SCABBARD MOUTH on the other side of the guard. These two hands must be physically separate and on opposite sides of ONE single gold guard.
In screen order, from LEFT to RIGHT: gold POMMEL -> short black/gold HANDLE partly covered by RIGHT HAND -> ONE GOLD GUARD -> a tiny 1cm gleam of blade -> LEFT HAND gripping SCABBARD THROAT -> long black SCABBARD -> scabbard tip.
The sword is a single rigid object, hilt/guard/blade root and scabbard share a continuous smooth axis, no kink, no disjoint pieces, no second guard, no floating fingers. Do not put BOTH hands on the sheath or both on the grip. Keep arms natural and visibly connected to their correct shoulders.
Clear waist-level weapon silhouette in front of the coat. The blade is almost entirely sheathed in this READY pose.

One complete character on genuinely transparent RGBA, square canvas with generous empty padding (12%) around hair, both boots, coat and sheath tip. Normal adult proportions, naturally small head and long limbs. No background, dragon, aura, effects, cast shadow, checkerboard, writing or UI. Preserve fine costume material details and stable approved identity. This is a clean physical character for later frame-by-frame animation.
